name: Strike Force Heroes 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: With its intense action, RPG elements, and a great variety of unlockables and game modes, Strike Force Heroes is an acclaimed game that makes you hooked from the beginning. Every single detail in this game –which spawned an equally acclaimed series of sequels- has been designed with extreme care, from its fabulous storyline to the engaging RPG elements that allow you to customize and improve your squad.
